We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family. About the role: Risk Adjustment accounts for differences in members’ health needs and expected cost of care. Accurate and complete clinical documentation helps ensure that a member’s health status is appropriately represented. Prospective Risk Adjustment focuses on proactively supporting opportunities for healthcare providers to review members’ health information and accurately document conditions addressed during clinical care, in accordance with applicable clinical coding and documentation requirements. These efforts may include sharing relevant clinical information with providers at the point of care, conducting virtual or in-home health assessments, and providing reports that identify historical or suspected conditions for provider review and clinical validation. The Analyst, Risk Adjustment supports the day-to-day execution and performance of Prospective Risk Adjustment programs. This role partners with internal teams and external vendors to ensure operational workflows are functioning as intended, program data and reporting are accurate, claims are processed appropriately, and operational issues are identified and resolved in a timely manner. The analyst will support a portfolio of initiatives including Point-of-Care tools, Virtual Health Assessments (VHA), In-Home Assessments (IHA), and provider reporting to support the review of member conditions. This role is well suited for an analytical, detail-oriented professional interested in developing expertise in Risk Adjustment and healthcare operations. You will report into the Sr. Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Risk Adjustment). Work Location: This position is based in our New York, NY office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $75,348- $98,894 per year. jobs.title: GTM Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy.  With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

 

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.


THE ROLE

You'll be Netic's first dedicated go-to-market data hire. Nobody owns our account and contact data end to end yet: you will. You'll define the data standards, build the models and checks that keep them accurate, and give the team a foundation for territories, routing, forecasting and commissions.

This is an analyst role with operational ownership. You'll spend as much time writing SQL and building models as you do fixing the processes that create bad data in the first place.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the GTM data model: define account, contact and hierarchy standards (parent companies, multi-location operators, PE-backed roll-ups), required fields at each stage, and the rules for creating, matching and merging records.

 - Build our total addressable market model: map every home services business by trade, geography and location count, score it, and keep it in sync with Salesforce.

 - Design and run enrichment workflows that keep firmographics and decision-maker contacts current, and measure the coverage and accuracy of each data source.

 - Define data quality metrics (duplicate rate, field completeness, match rate) and build the dashboards and alerts that catch bad data before it reaches a forecast or a commission statement.

 - Maintain the data behind territory assignments and lead routing, and give Sales Ops the evidence to resolve ownership disputes.

 - Run analyses that answer GTM questions: which segments convert, where coverage is thin, and which accounts we're missing.

 - Automate recurring cleanup and validation with our Sales Systems engineer, so hygiene runs as a system instead of a project.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

 - A documented standard for accounts, contacts and hierarchies that every team follows.

 - A TAM model the sales team uses to plan territories and prioritize accounts.

 - Data quality metrics tracked weekly, with duplicate rates and field gaps trending down.

 - Recurring cleanup automated rather than done by hand.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, marketing operations or data analytics at a B2B company.

 - Strong SQL and advanced Excel or Google Sheets; Python is a plus. You're comfortable building a model or analysis from raw, messy data.

 - Hands-on Salesforce data experience (Data Loader, Workbench or a dedupe tool) and a solid grasp of the object model.

 - A detail-first mindset. You notice when a number looks off and you chase it to the root cause.

 - The ownership to define standards, not only follow them, and the documentation habits to make them outlast you.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo, LeanData, Cloudingo or DemandTools.

 - Familiarity with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex) or a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery).

 - Experience using AI coding assistants to automate data work.

Our values

 1. Obsess over the customer

 2. Every second counts

 3. Sweat the details

 4. There are no blockers

 5. Be self-directed

 6. Seek and speak the truth

 7. Enjoy the ride
    
    

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Vertical Sales Strategy and Operations
jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins.

 - Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction.

 - Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting.
   
   

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

 - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

 - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.
   
   

What you bring

 - 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion

 - Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams.

 - Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

 - Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority.

 - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort operating in a fast-moving, undefined space.

 - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Customer Service Analytics & Insights Analyst
jobs.jd: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. Summary The CS Analytics & Insights Analyst combines two areas of work within Customer Service (CS). The first is demand forecasting judgment: interpreting the output of the CS demand forecast, applying informed overlays for events the model cannot yet see, explaining variances, and providing the final demand outlook used for staffing decisions. The second is CS Insights: using contact-driver analysis, customer-experience data and conversation analysis to explain why customers contact CS and where the opportunities are. The two areas reinforce each other. Contact-driver insights improve the forecast, and forecast variances point to the questions insights work should investigate. This is an analytical and operational role; forecasting tools and statistical models are maintained by partner teams. This role focuses on data and insight generated through Customer Service, and works alongside enterprise consumer-insights teams rather than in place of them. Responsibilities Forecasting judgment Interpret the CS demand forecast: review model output, identify where human judgment or overrides are warranted, and document the rationale. Build overlays and scenarios for known upcoming events (product launches, pricing and policy changes, live events, outages, marketing activity, market-specific anomalies) and quantify likely demand ranges. Perform forecast variance and root-cause analysis to understand not only how far the forecast missed but why, and identify systematic bias by market, channel, contact driver, horizon or event type. Share learnings with the teams that maintain the forecasting tools, and translate operational context into clear requirements for improvement. Maintain the forecasting calendar, assumptions, event inputs and forecast-accuracy measures. Provide the final demand outlook to Workforce Management and Capacity Planning partners, including assumptions about GenAI deflection and contact mix. Identify repeatable preparation, validation and QA work that can be automated. CS Insights Conduct CS contact-driver and customer-experience analysis to explain demand shifts, emerging friction points and the effect of product, pricing and policy changes on CS contacts. Support launch tracking and post-launch evaluation, and deliver recurring insights through templates and reports. Work with CS vendor partners to execute routine research tasks, provide clear instructions, and review outputs for quality. Contribute quantitative analysis, and over time qualitative and mixed-methods work, to research projects scoped with the CS Analytics & Insights Lead. Use GenAI and conversation-intelligence tools to analyze contacts at scale and surface emerging issues. Package findings into clear stories and recommendations for CS leadership and cross-functional partners. Across both areas Partner with Data Analysts on data requirements, datasets and dashboards that support forecasting and insights work. Support Streaming, Player Support and Games Moderation business units. Share coverage and best practices with fellow analysts on the team. Use GenAI tools as a standard part of how work is done, and continually look for ways to redesign forecasting and insights workflows around them. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Math, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience. 4+ years in analytics, customer insights, research, forecasting, workforce management or contact-center analytics, with a record of turning data into recommendations. Proficiency in SQL and spreadsheet modeling, and the ability to interrogate a model or dataset rather than accept its output at face value. Working understanding of forecasting concepts such as seasonality, event impacts, workload and forecast accuracy, or the ability to learn them quickly. Experience analyzing customer or CS contact data to identify drivers, trends and root causes. Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining forecast changes and research findings to non-technical and senior audiences. Demonstrated experience applying GenAI tools in analytical work. Preferred Direct experience owning or interpreting a contact-center demand forecast (interval, daily or weekly), including AHT and workload. Experience with modern forecasting tools, or Python/R beyond spreadsheet-based forecasting. Background combining forecasting with customer insights or research, with a strong foundation in statistics. Experience with qualitative or mixed-methods research, or with GenAI/NLP analysis of unstructured customer data. Experience in outsourced or multi-vendor contact-center environments. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $150,000.00 - $230,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location. jobs.title: Data Analyst-Associate (On-Site)
jobs.jd: Join a federally funded clinical and translational research laboratory whose active portfolio spans immune resilience, biological aging, military performance, infection, asthma, exercise physiology, heat stress, and trauma, with scientific output reaching multispecialty journals including Nature Communications and Aging Cell. The Data Analyst — Associate supports the research data management, reporting, and analytical workflows that underlie this portfolio. This position may be filled at multiple education and training levels, including candidates with a bachelor’s degree in biology, biostatistics, biomedical informatics, or a related field (with relevant analytical experience), candidates with a master’s degree, and candidates with a doctoral (PhD) degree. The specific appointment will be calibrated to the candidate’s background and the laboratory’s active analytical needs. Reporting to the Principal Investigator and senior analytical personnel, the Data Analyst — Associate contributes to the compilation, review, and submission of research data, reports, and documentation across the laboratory’s active studies. Core responsibilities include supporting data management for ongoing clinical and translational research, preparing study progress reports for federal sponsors and institutional stakeholders, developing ad hoc analytical reports as requested, maintaining documentation consistent with institutional and regulatory requirements, and ensuring that research reporting is accurate, timely, and audit-ready. The role is positioned to support scientific decision-making across the laboratory’s active federally funded research. This position supports research operations and academic activities, including clinical and translational research, and is not focused on financial analysis, budgeting, accounting, or financial reporting. Compile and report data to support institutional compliance requirements. Utilize basic programming techniques to extract, manipulate, analyze, and report data to internal and external constituencies. Utilizes existing algorithms to merge complex data into new datasets. Collaborates with team members across the institution to access data and articulate data requirements for various projects and initiatives. Assist in developing and maintaining data repositories and databases. Ensures compliance with deliverable reporting requirements by performing quality data audits and analysis. Perform ad-hoc analysis and provide recommendations based on data insights. Prepare reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate data effectively. Perform other duties as assigned. Experience in manipulating and analyzing data from varying sources to determine reporting needs and design specifications. Familiarity of empirical research and answering questions with data. Experience with statistical tools such as SPSS, SAS, or similar analytic tools. Experience in dashboard sustainment using visualization tools such as but not limited to Tableau. Proficient written and verbal skills, including the ability to convey information effectively. Ability to work with a diverse group of colleagues as part of a diverse and dynamic team. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
Hi, We're Centerfield!

Supercharged customer acquisition. Centerfield delivers outcome-based digital marketing solutions and personalized omnichannel experiences for the world’s leading brands. Powered by our proprietary Dugout platform, Centerfield acquires customers at scale for leading residential service, insurance, e-commerce, and B2B brands. Centerfield’s digital experiences and digital brands, such as Business.com http://Business.com and BroadbandNow.com http://BroadbandNow.com, reach more than 150 million in-market shoppers annually. Centerfield is headquartered in Silicon Beach and is proud to be recognized by Built in LA as a Best Place to Work in Los Angeles.


ROLE OVERVIEW...

We’re looking for a Data Scientist with 2+ years of experience to turn complex data into models, insights, and recommendations that improve business performance. You’ll tackle problems involving customer behavior, marketing effectiveness, sales conversion, and forecasting, partnering with business stakeholders, data engineers, and machine learning engineers.

This role combines a strong foundation in statistics and machine learning with the ability to apply AI and large language models (LLMs) to practical business problems.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES...

 - Partner with marketing, sales, and operations teams to define business problems, establish success metrics, and identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, and efficiency.

 - Explore and combine data from multiple sources using SQL and Python. Investigate data quality issues, develop features, and document assumptions.

 - Build and evaluate predictive models for use cases such as customer propensity, lifetime value, segmentation, and forecasting.

 - Apply statistical analysis and experimentation to understand performance drivers, measure impact, and communicate uncertainty and limitations.

 - Develop reusable analytical workflows and automate recurring analyses to support faster, more consistent decision-making.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate models into business workflows and monitor their performance over time.

 - Apply AI and LLMs to use cases such as extracting insights from unstructured data and supporting analytical workflows. Evaluate output quality, reliability, cost, and appropriate handling of data.

 - Present findings to technical and nontechnical audiences, explain trade-offs, and recommend clear next steps.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES...

 - 2+ years of experience in data science or a closely related role applying statistical analysis and machine learning to business problems.

 - Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data preparation, analysis, modeling, and evaluation.

 - A solid foundation in statistics and machine learning, including regression, classification, clustering, and hypothesis testing.

 - Experience with feature engineering, model validation, and selecting appropriate evaluation metrics, including an understanding of overfitting and data leakage.

 - Ability to work with AI and LLMs, demonstrated through professional, academic, or personal projects. Familiarity with prompting, working with model outputs, and evaluating their accuracy and reliability.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into a structured analytical approach and actionable recommendations.

 - Attention to data quality, reproducibility, and documentation, with familiarity using version control.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.


BONUS POINTS...

 - Experience with GCP, BigQuery, or comparable cloud data platforms.

 - Experience in digital marketing, customer acquisition, sales, or customer analytics.

 - Experience with forecasting, propensity modeling, customer lifetime value, or experiment design.

 - Familiarity with LLM APIs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or evaluating AI-powered applications.

 - Experience partnering with engineering teams to deploy and monitor models.

jobs.title: Pricing Strategy Analyst (Remote)
jobs.jd: We're looking for a Pricing Strategy Analyst to join Procore's Corporate Strategy team. In this role, you'll be the data and analytics engine behind our pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy, turning transaction, sales, and product data into the commercial signals that inform our decisions. You'll also lead smaller pricing initiatives across the full Procore portfolio, including our emerging AI offerings. The primary goal of this role is to make sure Procore's pricing decisions are grounded in clear, accurate, and well-sourced data. As a Pricing Strategy Analyst , you'll partner with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing to analyze how our pricing and packaging perform in the market and to build the visibility needed to improve them. Use your structured problem-solving, data analysis, and executive communication skills to shape how Procore captures value from what we build and buy. If you want hands-on work to drive top line growth and connect everyone in construction, apply today and join our team! This position reports to the Senior Manager of Pricing & Monetization Strategy and can be based remotely in the US. We're looking for someone to join us immediately. What you'll do: Lead pricing and packaging initiatives from hypothesis through recommendation, in partnership with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing Build and stress-test the business case behind pricing decisions, including segment-level performance, cannibalization-adjusted ARR impact, and migration and monetization sizing. Analyze transaction, bookings, discounting, and product data to identify the commercial signals that explain how our pricing and packaging perform, and diagnose the root cause when they underperform, whether it is package design, sales execution, or market fit. Design and run market, competitive, and willingness-to-pay research, including win/loss and price elasticity analysis, to pressure-test pricing hypotheses before they reach leadership. Build and maintain pricing and packaging reporting and dashboards that give Product, Sales, and Finance visibility into performance, working with data teams to keep metrics and data sources accurate and consistent. Translate analysis into a small number of clear, claim-driven recommendations, present them to executive leaders, and defend them under challenge. Partner with Pricing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Marketing to make sure approved decisions are operationalized and communicated to the field. What we’re looking for: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in pricing, monetization, strategy, business or data analytics, financial planning and analysis, or consulting wi th 2+ y ears inside a pricing or monetization practice at a top-tier strategy firm Track record of framing ambiguous problems into clear analytical frameworks and presenting recommendations to cross-functional and senior audiences. Experience leading projects or workstreams from analysis through recommendation, with the ability to balance multiple priorities. Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with experience building revenue impact and unit economics models. Hands-on experience querying and analyzing large datasets (e.g., SQL), building reports in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus Ability to synthesize qualitative inputs, such as call transcripts and field feedback, into clear themes that support pricing recommendations. Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills, with experience partnering with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing teams. Familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics (e.g., ARR, net revenue retention, win rate, discount rate) is a plus Curiosity, high agency, and an owner’s mindset with a strong bias for action. Additional Information Base Pay Range: 81,600.00 - 112,200.00 USD Annual This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. jobs.salary: $115K – $148K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Multiple Ranges
jobs.jd:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.




TEAM OVERVIEW

Marketing Operations keeps Deepgram's go-to-market engine measurable. As our first Marketing & GTM Data Analyst, you'll build the reporting and analytics function rather than inherit a finished one, and own the answer to what's working and where to invest next. You'll partner with the Director of Marketing Operations on the weekly GTM report leadership reads, and with our Decision Intelligence and Data Engineering teams on AI analytics agents and the GTM data foundation. Your work will power Marketing, Product, SDR, AE, Partnerships, and RevOps.




KEY GOALS

 - Automate recurring GTM analytics with Decision Intelligence, designing and improving AI agents for weekly reporting, campaign and sales play readouts, scoring-model checks, and anomaly alerts, as the GTM expert who writes evaluation cases and QAs their output.

 - Own Marketing and GTM KPI definitions, calculation logic, and the weekly report leadership reads, with a clear narrative on what changed and why.

 - Measure marketing campaigns and SDR/AE sales plays from first touch through closed-won, using pre/post and cohort analysis to say what to scale, fix, or stop.

 - Create reusable campaign and sales play reporting templates with consistent definitions, time windows, and attribution rules, structured so AI agents can generate first drafts.

 - Own Dreamdata and evolve our attribution practices (multi-touch, sourcing rules, SDR credit, partner attribution), reconcile them with Salesforce and HubSpot, and turn attribution into budget recommendations.

 - Evaluate and improve MQL, PQL, and account intent scoring models, with automated monitoring of precision, coverage, and conversion lift by score.

 - Define and report partner and business development performance, including partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, co-marketing results, and performance by tier.

 - Define GTM source-of-truth datasets with Data Engineering and Decision Intelligence, write the semantic context AI analytics agents rely on, and drive data quality fixes upstream.


MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & CAPABILITIES

 - Turns vague or complex requests ("did re:Invent work?", "why is pipeline soft?") into clear, answerable questions before touching data, and pushes back constructively when the question is wrong.

 - Understands the B2B funnel (MQL, SAL, SQL, Closed Won) and how marketing, product-led, partner, SDR, and AE motions interact, and explains why the numbers look the way they do.

 - Writes strong SQL directly in a warehouse and across Salesforce objects (Leads, Contacts, Campaigns, Campaign Members, Opportunities, custom objects).

 - Reconciles messy data across systems, holds a high bar for what counts as right, and fixes problems at the source rather than patching downstream.

 - Has owned or improved a multi-touch attribution setup and reconciled it with CRM data.

 - Evaluates or tunes lead, PQL, or account scoring models and measures whether they improve conversion.

 - Operates AI-native: builds AI agents or agentic workflows for analytics (e.g., Claude Code, MCP servers, n8n), automates recurring analysis, and writes the evaluation cases and context agents need to be accurate.

 - Builds dashboards and recurring reports in a BI tool that people rely on and act on, with a narrative sized for leadership.

 - Owns KPI definitions so the same number means the same thing everywhere.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE-TO-HAVE, NOT REQUIRED)

 - Typically ~3–5 years in marketing analytics, GTM or revenue analytics, or a similar analytical role at a B2B SaaS company, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

 - Hands-on with Dreamdata, HockeyStack, Bizible, or a similar attribution tool, plus HubSpot and Salesforce reporting.

 - Python, and experience with dbt, semantic layers, or metric stores.

 - Worked with intent data or partner attribution.

 - Experience at a usage-based, developer-focused, or product-led business.


OUR VALUES

 - Be You — bring your whole self and a different perspective; diverse viewpoints make our products better.

 - Be Curious — challenge the status quo, keep learning, and ask 'how might we?' instead of accepting limits.

 - Grow Together — push each other to do great work, treat feedback as a gift, and leave the drama out.

 - Do the Right Thing — act with integrity and candor, assume best intent, choose ethics over expediency.

 - Think Smart. Act Fast. — weigh the high-leverage options, decide, and move; no analysis paralysis.

 - Put the Customer First — listen with empathy, understand their goals, and let their success drive ours.



We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting great candidates — so please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.jd: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. Analytics Engineer We’re hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization. We’re building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer. Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You’ll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions. You’ll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You’ll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond. What You’ll Do: Partner with the business. Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust. Own ingestion for your domains. Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures. Model the business. Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it. Own the semantic layer. Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent’s answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives. Power self-service in ThoughtSpot. Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases. Own the quality of conversational analytics. Test answers the way you’d test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation. Apply governance day to day. Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see. Keep it fast and fresh. Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent’s answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check. Work AI-native. Lead with specs, then hand agents end-to-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work. What We Look For: You have 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on. You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production. You’ve worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. You’ve worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source-data issues such as schema changes, late-arriving data, and API limits. You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles. You’ve built dashboards or self-service data products that people use to make decisions. You test and document your work as a habit. You’re curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building. You use AI agents for real multi-step work, like writing SQL and dbt models, generating tests, and drafting documentation, and you verify what they produce. You explain your work clearly to technical and non-technical partners. You take ownership. You see work through, ask for help when you’re stuck, and look for ways to make things better. Bonus Points You’ve evaluated LLM or natural-language analytics output, for example with golden sets or regression testing. You’ve worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer-centric, multi-location business. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 



Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.


The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.


Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 



The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 



We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.



This analyst turns Outset's own data into decisions faster than a traditional analytics hire would, by using AI tools as a core part of the workflow rather than bolting them on afterward. They're as comfortable writing a SQL query to understand critical business data accurately, as they are building a small internal tool, script, or AI skill that answers a recurring question without a human re-running it every week. 

The job is part analysis, part automation - someone who'd rather build the dashboard-that-builds-itself than ship the same report by hand twice. Improving processes and workflows across the company excites them and they love to build tools to help internal teams across the business move, manage and understand data.



Responsibilities

 - Answer recurring business questions across GTM, People, Product and Engineering using SQL, Python, and whatever AI tooling gets there fastest.

 - Build small internal tools - vibe coded apps, Slack bots, scripts, lightweight dashboards, AI skills - that eliminate a manual report or a repeated ad hoc request.

 - Partner with stakeholders to figure out what they actually need before building anything.

 - Maintain and improve data pipelines so the underlying numbers are trustworthy, not just the tools on top of them.

 - Evaluate new AI tools and workflows as they come out, and decide which are actually worth adopting internally vs. hype.

 - Document what you build well enough that someone else can run it without you in the room.

 - Flag data quality issues and inconsistent definitions before they turn into bad decisions.

Qualifications

 - 3+ years in a data analyst, analytics engineer, or BI role, with real SQL and Python fluency.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to build something real - a script, an agent, an automation - not just to summarize text.

 - A builder's instinct: when a manual process repeats twice, the next step is automating it, not doing it a third time.

 - Able to go from a vague stakeholder ask to a specific, well-scoped answer without heavy hand-holding.

 - Clear written communication - can explain a finding or a tool to someone non-technical in a few sentences.

 - Experience at a startup where the data stack and tooling were still being built, not inherited mature.

 - Exposure to building or prompting AI agents/workflows (not just using chat interfaces).

 - Familiarity with modern BI/data tools (dbt, Looker, Hex, or similar).

Job Description Counterparty Risk Group The counterparty credit risk management function is responsible for the management and control of counterparty risk at US Bank. The group provides independent review of counterparty risk across the business, producing detailed analysis of the derivative portfolio for internal and external constituents and manage the control framework under which counterparty risk is governed. Job Description Responsible for conducting pre-trade counterparty credit risk analysis for a broad range of products, including interest rate derivatives, foreign exchange (FX) derivatives, commodity derivatives, credit derivatives, and repo transactions . The role involves quantifying counterparty risk exposure through measures such as Expected Exposure (EE), Potential Future Exposure (PFE), and stressed exposure metrics to assess the potential impact of adverse market movements and counterparty default. The analyst evaluates proposed transactions against approved credit limits, risk appetite, collateral arrangements, and regulatory requirements to ensure appropriate risk-taking and limit compliance prior to trade execution. Working closely with trading, credit, and risk management teams, the analyst identifies material risk concentrations, recommends risk mitigants where necessary, and helps ensure that counterparty credit risk is accurately measured, monitored, and controlled across the trading portfolio. Basic Qualifications - Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience - Typically more than six years of applicable experience Preferred Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline, with 2-4 years of experience in counterparty risk, market risk, trading, CVA, or a related quantitative risk management function ; or Master's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 1-2 years of relevant experience in counterparty risk, market risk, trading, CVA, or quantitative analytics . Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to evaluate and interpret complex risk exposures. Understanding of counterparty credit risk concepts, including Expected Exposure (EE), Potential Future Exposure (PFE), CVA, collateral management, and netting agreements . Knowledge of financial products such as interest rate derivatives, FX derivatives, commodity derivatives, credit derivatives, and repo transactions . Ability to assess transactions against counterparty credit limits and identify material risk drivers. Proficiency in data analysis and risk reporting tools; experience with Python, SQL, VBA, or risk management platforms is a plus. Strong communication skills with the ability to present risk assessments and recommendations to trading, credit, and senior risk management stakeholders. jobs.jd: Job Summary: WHO ARE WE? Run social listening across tour cycles (from announcements, on-sales to live moments), tracking fan sentiment, conversation volume, and flagging shifts in real time. Run competitive and benchmark analysis to contextualize our performance. Partner with social listening-tool vendors and cross-functional teams to improve benchmarks, KPIs, alerts, and depth of insight. Uncover fan insights through audience demographics to help guide campaign planning WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 2–4 years in social media analytics, social listening, and/or digital insights with a focus on earned measurement (agency or in-house social team preferred). Hands-on experience with social listening and publishing tools (Meltwater, Brandwatch, Sprout, Quid, etc.) plus platform-native analytics. Comfortable with audience demographic tools such as Audiense as well as platform follower demographics through CreatorIQ. Fluency in earned-social metrics (share of voice, sentiment, mention volume) and a clear sense of which ones actually matter. Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and a solid grasp of Boolean logic for query development. Proven ability to own analytics end-to-end (query design, reporting, dashboard development and maintenance), with a track record of spotting and fixing gaps in reporting infrastructure. Deep understanding of social platforms as both a fan and an analyst: how conversation forms, why things spread, what fans respond to, plus genuine curiosity about cultural trends, emerging formats, and creator marketing. Strong communication skills: you can turn a spike in conversation into a one-slide "so what" for non-technical stakeholders. Detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines under pressure. A proactive, collaborative team player who flags insights before they're asked for and adapts to evolving leadership needs. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Analytics, or a related field. NICE TO HAVE: Passion for live music, touring, and artist marketing. Experience with sentiment analysis, text/topic classification, or unstructured conversation data. jobs.title: Data Scientist (Decision Science)
jobs.jd:
About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.  

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.  

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.  

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.  

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. 

 

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist to develop data solutions that will enable us to assist critical day to day business decisions.

As a Data Scientist in the Decision Science role, you will have the opportunity to apply analytics, experimentation and machine learning algorithms to support and enhance MoneyLion’s products with data driven decisions.

You will be embedded within the product teams and deliver tangible business value by deploying or refining solutions ranging from fraud and credit underwriting to user experience optimisations, providing convincing evidence of their effectiveness. This entails designing, developing, validating, deploying and monitoring the outcome of experiments using (and refining) business objectives that will ultimately increase revenue and reduce business costs. You will partner with Product, Data Engineers and Machine Learning teams, exploring and utilizing the frontier of innovation, in order to augment analytics with AI, rapidly iterate with configurable experiments, monitor and evaluate key developments, and understand business needs intimately to help develop valuable AI solutions.

 

About MoneyLion

MoneyLion is a leader in financial technology powering the next generation of personalized products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. MoneyLion’s mission is to give everyone the power to make their best financial decisions. We pride ourselves on serving the many, not the few; providing confidence through guidance, choice, personalization; and shortening the distance to an informed action.

In our go-to money app for consumers, we deliver curated content on finance and related topics, through a tailored feed that engages people to learn and share. People take control of their finances with our innovative financial products and marketplace - including our full-fledged suite of features to save, borrow, spend, and invest - seamlessly bringing together the best offers and content from MoneyLion and our 1,100+ Enterprise Partner network, together in one experience. MoneyLion’s enterprise technology provides the definitive search engine and marketplace for financial products, enabling any company to add embedded finance to their business, with advanced AI-backed data and tools through our platform and API. Established in 2013, MoneyLion connects millions of people with the financial products and content they need, when and where they need it.

 

Key Responsibilities

 - Perform analyses to understand how our users interact with our products and how to improve our products

 - Communicate findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner

 - Identify anomalies and investigate the root causes of anomalies

 - Design and build experiments to solve challenging data and business problems

 - Collaborate with product owners to discover new insights and understanding of business performance based on data

 - Identify trends and opportunities from the data and influence product roadmaps

 - Develop dashboards to track relevant metrics

 - Recommend ways to measure success

 - Work with engineers to improve the data collection process

 - Ensure data-driven decision making within the organization

 - Apply, develop or refine AI algorithms to deliver business value

 

About You

 - Strong mathematical, statistical or actuarial background

 - Must have hands on experience in machine learning, predictive analytics and statistical modeling

 - Proficiency with A/B testing and experimentation framework is preferred

 - Adept at problem solving using both textbook methods and novel viewpoints

 - Proficient in programming languages such as Python and SQL

 - Knowledge of data structures, data modeling, software architecture and machine learning algorithms will be an advantage

 - Demonstrably experienced with data visualization

 - Demonstrably excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

What's Next...

jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations, Agents
jobs.jd:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Commure builds AI for healthcare operations. Call Center Agents is our AI voice agent for medical practice and health system call centers. It answers and places patient calls, schedules and reschedules appointments, and plugs directly into the EHR, so calls end with work done rather than a message left.

We sell to health systems, specialty practices, FQHCs, and behavioral health networks. The product is moving fast, the market is crowded with well-funded competitors, and the team is small enough that one person can shape how the whole sales motion runs.

You'll be the person who makes the sales team measurably better every quarter. That means owning the numbers (pipeline, forecast, targets, rep performance) and the people side that moves them: coaching individual sellers and keeping the whole team sharp on a product that ships something new every few weeks.

You'll sit in deal reviews, tell us where the forecast is wrong before it's wrong, figure out why one rep converts discovery calls at twice the rate of another, and turn that into a training the rest of the team runs with the next week. If you've done sales strategy and ops at a high-growth company and want more scope, more ownership, and a mission in healthcare, this is that job.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Set strategy and plan the business

 - Partner with the call center leadership on go-to-market strategy across segments: health systems, specialty practices, FQHCs, and behavioral health.

 - Lead territory design, target setting, and quota allocation. Translate company goals into field-level numbers each rep believes in.

 - Model capacity and hiring plans: how many reps, SEs, and implementation resources we need to hit the plan, and when.

 - Help design and administer sales comp, including SPIFs that push the behaviors we need.

Evaluate and improve individual sales performance

 - Build a performance scorecard for every seller: activity, pipeline generation, stage conversion, cycle time, win rate, and deal size.

 - Diagnose where each rep is losing deals (discovery, champion building, ROI case, procurement) using CRM data, call recordings, and deal reviews.

 - Run regular 1:1 performance reviews with reps and their managers. Agree on two or three specific things to improve and track whether they do.

 - Spot what top performers do differently and make it the playbook for everyone else.

Enable and train the team

 - Own sales enablement for Call Center Agents: onboarding for new hires and ongoing training for the existing team.

 - Run trainings whenever the product changes so every seller can demo, position, and price new capabilities the week they ship.

 - Build and maintain the core assets: pitch and demo scripts, discovery guides, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and ROI calculators.

 - Certify reps on the product and the pitch through role plays and mock calls, and retrain where the data shows gaps.

 - Be the link between Product and Sales: bring field feedback to the product team and bring product updates back to the field.

Build the systems

 - Own CRM hygiene, deal stage definitions, and KPI definitions so everyone reads the same numbers.

 - Build dashboards and reporting that reps, managers, and leadership actually use.

 - Move us from spreadsheets to scalable tools as we grow, and use AI tools to make the whole machine faster.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4+ years in sales strategy and operations, revenue operations, or GTM strategy at a high-growth tech company. Consulting, banking, or chief-of-staff experience before that is a plus.

 - You've run the core sales rhythm yourself: forecasting, pipeline reviews, business reviews, target setting, and territory or quota planning.

 - You've worked directly with sellers, not just their data. You can sit with a rep, look at their pipeline, and tell them specifically what to do differently.

 - You're comfortable in front of a room. You've built and delivered trainings, onboarding, or enablement programs that changed how a team sells.

 - Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel or Sheets, comfortable building models from scratch. SQL is a plus.

 - Hands-on with Salesforce or HubSpot, including reports and dashboards.

 - You bring structure to ambiguity with low ego. You'll build the deck, then clean up the CRM, then run the meeting.

 - Clear, concise writer and communicator with reps, managers, and executives alike.



Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com http://commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

jobs.title: Market Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns a fleet of distributed batteries and the households we serve into a power business that makes money. As a Market Analyst, you’ll know how much Base is earning, where it could lose money, and how it will make money in the next market.

You’ll own P&L (profit and loss) reporting and risk tracking across our battery fleet and retail operations. You’ll build the pricing models behind what we charge members, recommend hedges, and work with Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy to figure out how Base makes money in each new market. Base already does this in ERCOT. Your first job is to do it in PJM.

This role suits someone with a few years of experience in power markets, retail energy, or a related analytical field. You’ll own real decisions early.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a bottoms-up retail pricing model for PJM that builds upon our ERCOT model.

 - Bring PJM into our risk system and P&L reporting, so we know the margin we earn and how to buy supply.

 - Identify new market opportunities and work closely with stakeholders from Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy teams to bring them to reality.

 - Recommend changes to Base’s hedging strategy in ERCOT and PJM, and track our exposure against risk limits.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Energy markets knowledge: you understand wholesale market basics in ERCOT and PJM, including how power is bought, hedged and settled. You know how retail pricing and operations work.

 - Commercial sense: you understand how a retail offer makes or loses money. You can explain the cost to supply it, the margin on it, and the risk in between.

 - Risk and statistics: you think in distributions, not point forecasts. You know power prices are tail heavy. Basic statistics is enough.

 - Coding and SQL: you build reports and models in Python (or another language), pull your own data with SQL, and work through a problem independently.

Nice to have: experience at a retail energy provider, utility supply desk, or trading middle office.



ABOUT THE TEAM

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns the grid-service capability of our distributed battery fleet into revenue. That means building and defending the models that decide which markets and products Base participates in, from real-time arbitrage to multi-year distribution deals. The team’s calls carry real weight - a mis-modeled coincident peak or an unvetted market opinion shows up directly in Base’s book. You’ll work alongside traders, market operations engineers, and policy leads who bring the same rigor to distribution-scale energy that a trading desk brings to wholesale power.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.



About the Role:

Rho’s data has two types of consumers: people and AI agents. As our data analyst, you will empower both with reliable data and meaningful insights. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role that involves everything from data pipelining to delivering recommendations. You will model new data for Rho’s latest features and product lines. You will build the semantic layer that defines how Rho measures itself and turn analyses into decisions with stakeholders across the whole business.



The increased adoption of agentic tools and the acceleration of Rho’s own product velocity result in more people consuming data, more data-backed outputs, and even more business questions to answer. More than ever, it’s imperative that a data team ensures reliable self-service data for routine reporting or inbound requests while being hands-on for deeper analysis that drives decision-making.



You’re accountable for faster and data-driven decision-making, not for the number of dashboards or reports built. This is a cross-functional role that will interface with data engineering as well as business-side stakeholders from GTM, Product, and other departments. This role is based in our New York office and reports to our Manager, Product Analytics who is also based there.

What You’ll Do

 - Drive business decision-making by working directly with stakeholders across the company to scope ambiguous questions, conduct analyses, and transform analyses into clear, actionable recommendations.

 - Proactively uncover opportunity areas as a holder of domain knowledge across verticals. Operate flexibly across verticals and function as a subject matter expert on data sources and key metrics.

 - Uphold data integrity and governance standards by maintaining consistent metric definitions within the dbt semantic layer.

 - Own BI reporting for multiple verticals, ranging from Compliance to GTM. Build or tune any required reporting, and safely deprecate obsolete assets.

What You Bring

 - 2 to 4 years of experience as a data analyst, business analyst, analytics engineer, business intelligence engineer, or similar role

 - A growth mindset and ability to quickly learn about new business domains or product surface areas in a fast-moving environment

 - Outstanding SQL ability, and particularly comfortable with debugging complex logic

 - Track record of translating data insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders

 - Hands-on experience building models in dbt or similar data transformation frameworks

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to adapt to audiences of varying technical backgrounds

 - You already use AI to move faster, whether it’s by automating repetitive tasks or drafting initial analyses. You are curious about what’s next.

 - Prior experience in building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Omni, Hex, Tableau, and other business intelligence or analytical tools

Nice to Have

 - Experience working in financial services, banking, technology or a fast-paced startup

 - Experience supporting multiple verticals or departments simultaneously

 - Experience building out a dbt semantic layer and refining the warehouse as a surface area for both humans and AI agents

 - Familiarity with machine learning concepts and predictive analytics

Pay

 - Our target compensation range for this role is: $120K to $150K, with variation based on relevant experience, skills, and business needs. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Security Experiences, Analytics and Science Team

In this role, you will build and maintain BI solutions (datasets, queries, reports, dashboards, and analyses) that inform how security leadership makes decisions across Amazon. Working on well-defined problems with guidance from senior engineers, you will maintain data lineage understanding, apply analytics and visualization tools, and deliver reliable insights on schedule. You will partner with teams across ASE, BizOps, MapSec, and other security organizations to translate business questions into data-driven answers that serve the broader Amazon Security organization. Key job responsibilities Learn and apply team BI best practices when building data artifacts including ETL, data models, queries, and reports. jobs.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
WHAT THE ROLE DOES

Turn data into better product decisions.

As a Business Data Analyst, you will partner with Product Owners to design experiments, analyze customer behaviour, and turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Your work will influence product roadmaps across key customer journeys, including conversion, engagement, and renewals.

You will go beyond reporting results. You will apply statistical rigour, investigate unexpected findings, challenge assumptions constructively, and uncover opportunities that improve the customer experience and business performance. This role is for a curious, proactive analyst who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of analytical initiatives, and turns insights into meaningful action to uncover opportunities and strengthen how we measure, report, and make decisions across the business.

This is a full-time, permanent position working 37.5 hours per week, with the option to work hybrid from our Edmonton, Alberta office.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Collaborate with Product Owners to design and plan experiments, define requirements, assumptions, and limitations

 - Explore and analyze experiment data to understand customer behaviour, usage patterns, and performance drivers

 - Lead multiple analytical initiatives, using findings to recommend clear next steps and inform priorities

 - Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover customer behaviour trends, friction points, and growth opportunities

 - Use AI tools to research internal documentation and tools, support SQL and code development, and review analytical work efficiently

 - Build dashboards and automated reports to improve accessibility and insight quality

 - Translate business questions into measurable metrics

 - Deliver data based recommendations and clearly identify actionable next steps

 - Improve tracking plans, event quality, and attribution logic to ensure accurate and reliable measurement

 - Write and optimize SQL queries and notebooks to support analysis

 - Communicate data analysis results, insights, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders

 - Collaborate with fellow analysts to review results, refine methodologies, and strengthen analytical approaches


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Post-secondary education in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or other related programs

 - 3+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, or data science

 - Strong statistical judgment, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power considerations, and the ability to distinguish meaningful findings from noise

 - Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex analysis clearly

 - Solid understanding of statistics and experiment analysis

 - Proficiency in SQL, including writing efficient queries with joins, aggregations, and filtering logic

 - Knowledge of data mining and segmentation techniques

 - Familiarity with Python for data analysis and visualization (ex. pandas, Matplotlib)

 - Ability to manage multiple experiments and analyses simultaneously

 - Proficiency using Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Visualizations, Formulas)

 - Ability to work independently and manage complex projects

 - Strong interest in data analysis and a natural tendency to dig deeper into unexpected results

 - Experience using AI-enabled development environments such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Copilot


WHAT SETS YOU APART

 - Experience analyzing and designing A/B experiments

 - Ability to structure ambiguous problems into analytical plans

 - Confidence challenging assumptions while maintaining strong working relationships

 - Proactive mindset that goes beyond answering questions to identifying new opportunities

 - Comfortable presenting insights to Product Owners and leadership


WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN THE LAWDEPOT TEAM

 - Excellent total compensation package

 - Comprehensive health and dental benefits, plus an additional Health Care Spending / Personal Spending Account

 - Great work life balance (37.5 hour work weeks, flexible schedules, ability to bank hours)

 - Three weeks paid vacation, plus bonus personal days

 - Continuous learning opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and training budgets

 - Company share plan

 - Free catered lunches for the entire office

 - Monthly social events for team members to enjoy (think axe throwing, rock climbing, board games, food trucks, trivia contests, and charitable activities)

 - Work alongside talented, driven colleagues in a culture focused on quality, reliability, innovation, and growth

 - Personal offices for focused work and to have your individual space (plus collaborative workspaces for when you want to meet with the team)

 - Free and easily accessible parking

 - Southgate Mall, Whyte Ave, and Calgary Trail restaurants are only minutes away

 - Hybrid working arrangements for that balance between getting work done at home and engaging with others in the office


WHO WE ARE

Join one of the fastest growing companies in Canada! LawDepot is proud to be a seven-time Growth 500 ranked organization and a major player in the Global legal solutions industry. Our mission is to modernize the legal document creation experience by empowering people with fast, easy-to-use, and professional solutions. With over ten million satisfied customers worldwide, over two million monthly website visitors, and billions of dollars saved on legal fees, you will be joining a team that is truly making a difference. At LawDepot, we foster a collaborative and inclusive learning culture that values excellence. Apply today and become a part of our exciting journey!

Apply for this job here or submit your application through our Careers page at https://www.lawdepot.ca/career.

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst - Network Optimization

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. What Success Looks Like

 - Test readouts are timely, accurate, and easy to understand.

Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills, including experience working with complex datasets and automating analytical workflows. Experience investigating data from multiple systems, reconciling inconsistencies, establishing data-quality controls, and developing reliable analytical datasets. Familiarity with modern development practices and platforms such as Git or GitHub, cloud infrastructure, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable technologies.
